title: Kitten wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,12 38,34 62,34' fill='#FF69B4'/>
  <polygon points='50,12 44,34 50,34' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='50,12 56,34 62,34' fill='#00E5FF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='3.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='26' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='26' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <polygon points='30,40 26,22 40,34' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <polygon points='70,40 74,22 60,34' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <polygon points='31,37 29,27 38,34' fill='#FF9BD2'/>
  <polygon points='69,37 71,27 62,34' fill='#FF9BD2'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='50' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='50' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='49' rx='2.2' ry='2.8' fill='#111111'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='49' rx='2.2' ry='2.8' fill='#111111'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='47.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='57.5' cy='47.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <polygon points='50,56 47,59 53,59' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M46,62 Q50,66 54,62' fill='none' stroke='#C06A3A' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1='28' y1='54' x2='16' y2='51' stroke='#E8A050' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='58' x2='16' y2='59' stroke='#E8A050' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='54' x2='84' y2='51' stroke='#E8A050' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='58' x2='84' y2='59' stroke='#E8A050' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <!-- Chest patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='10' ry='10' fill='#FFF3D6'/>
  <!-- Paws -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='95' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='95' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M68,88 Q84,82 82,70 Q80,62 72,66' fill='none' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='58' r='4' fill='#FF8C9E' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='58' r='4' fill='#FF8C9E' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
